verdict: White rice is usually easier to control when losing weight. It saves about 400 kcal, and you can choose your own protein dishes.
why: A cup of white rice is about 200 kcal. A plate of nasi goreng kampung is about 600 kcal, which is 3 times more.
White rice has only about 1 g of fat. Nasi goreng kampung has about 24 g, mostly from cooking oil and fried ikan bilis.
Nasi goreng kampung has more protein (about 20 g vs 4 g). But white rice + a piece of chicken or fish can reach the same protein with fewer calories.
Fried rice is easy to eat fast and finish a full plate. White rice is easier to control, for example asking for half or just one cup.
when_a: White rice suits almost every day, especially at a nasi campur warung. Make sure you have a protein dish and vegetables.
when_b: Nasi goreng kampung is still okay once in a while, for example dinner after an active day or when you lepak with friends. Balance it with lighter meals at other times.
tip: If you order nasi goreng kampung, ask for less oil, add a fried egg (not crispy) and vegetables. Then share it or pack half for tomorrow.

faq.q: Isn't white rice the reason people gain weight?
faq.a: Not necessarily. What matters is your total calories for the day. A cup of rice with a protein dish and vegetables can fit into a weight-loss plan.

faq.q: What if I still want nasi goreng?
faq.a: You can. Choose a regular size, less oil, and add egg or chicken. Avoid adding keropok and sweet drinks in the same meal.
